headline: Tata Motors faces supply chain disruption amid regional conflict
article_text: Tata Motors announced potential production halts at several assembly plants due to escalated geopolitical tensions disrupting semiconductor freight corridors.

headline: HDFC Bank posts record quarterly net profit growth
article_text: HDFC Bank reported a strong 18 percent year-on-year increase in quarterly net profit driven by robust retail loan expansions and declining gross non-performing assets.

headline: Regulatory probe initiated over alleged refining tariff irregularities
article_text: Securities regulators have requested audit documentation from Reliance Industries regarding pipeline transmission tariff calculations and environmental compliance disclosures.

headline: Infosys launches next-generation enterprise AI orchestration suite
article_text: Infosys announced the global release of its Topaz Cognitive Platform aimed at automating corporate workflows and accelerating generative enterprise integrations.

headline: Credit rating downgraded to negative outlook on high leverage
article_text: Rating agencies placed long-term debt instruments of Adani Enterprises on negative credit watch citing heightened refinancing costs and tight liquidity buffers.

headline: Central Bank unexpectedly raises benchmark repo rate by 50 basis points
article_text: The Reserve Bank tightened benchmark policy rates by half a percentage point to curb accelerating core inflation pressures across lending markets.

headline: Tata Steel announces merger discussions with regional infrastructure supplier
article_text: Tata Steel has entered non-binding exploratory talks to acquire a 60 percent equity stake in an infrastructure steel specialist to fortify domestic supply chains.

headline: Major cross-border sanctions disrupt battery component logistics
article_text: Sanctions targeting mineral processing hubs have constrained battery pack shipments, leading to warnings of margin contraction across auto manufacturers.

headline: Apple reports record iPhone demand across emerging markets
article_text: Apple announced robust quarterly operational revenue, beating consensus Wall Street estimates behind accelerated smartphone market penetration in India and Southeast Asia.

headline: HDFC Bank issues multi-currency green bond tranche
article_text: HDFC Bank successfully priced 750 million dollars in sustainable green bonds to fund certified renewable energy infrastructure and eco-friendly housing projects.

headline: Crude oil volatility and maritime blockades pressure refining spreads
article_text: Geopolitical tensions in key shipping straits triggered an eight percent spike in benchmark crude oil futures, squeezing downstream petrochemical margins.

headline: Infosys settles dispute with client consortium out of court
article_text: Infosys resolved a pending contract valuation dispute regarding custom cloud implementation milestones with an agreed non-material settlement fee.
